description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Blockchain' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. On-chain integration config — chain selectors, smart contract addresses, RPC overrides, gas policy, supported networks for Crypto currencies. Built largely from Currency.CryptoCurrencies[].Networks; this is the title-level companion config.

BlockchainAccountSafetyPolicy.description: Anti-fraud / anti-multiaccount policies for crypto operations. Applied before creating withdrawal requests; deposits are always accepted but may flag the account.

BanOnSharedWithdrawalAddress.description: Ban on attempting to withdraw to an address previously used by another account.

MinAccountAgeDays.description: Minimum account age (in days) required for withdrawal. Defense against "register-deposit-withdraw-to-third-party" laundering schemes.

MultiAccountCheckEnabled.description: Enable check: the same wallet address across different UserIDs results in banning both accounts.

PendingWithdrawalTtlHours.description: Pending withdrawal TTL in hours. Past the TTL the request is auto-cancelled and funds return from Frozen to Amount.

BlockchainNetworkDefinition.description: Definition of a single network. NFT collections available here are listed in NftCollections. Token contracts are bound to crypto currencies elsewhere.

AssetPaths.description: Network assets (logos, etc.). Purpose is defined by client convention.

ChainConfigVersion.description: Chain config version. Controls the withdrawal signature payload format (V2 includes UserID, V1 does not).

ChainID.description: EVM chain ID. 0 for Solana (not used).

ChainTicker.description: Chain ticker (e.g. "eth", "bsc"), shown in the dashboard. The engine replaces it with the platform registry's ticker; RPC is built only from the registry.

GasPrice.description: Read-only. Network gas price (EVM) from the platform registry. Never taken from title config.

NftBridgeAddress.description: Read-only. EVM ItemBridge address (NFT deposit destination and mint-withdrawal contract), set by the engine from the platform registry. Empty falls back to RewardPoolAddress.

NftCollections.description: NFT collections available for deposit/withdraw in this network. The specific ItemID is resolved through the item catalog by NftTokenID (EVM) or mint address (Solana).

PlatformOverrides.description: Per-platform overrides (e.g. disable the network on iOS, keep on Android).

RequiredConfirmations.description: Ignored: the platform sets the confirmation depth (EVM 2 blocks, Solana confirmed).

RewardPoolAddress.description: Read-only. Platform pool contract (EVM) / Program ID (Solana), set by the engine from the platform registry. Never taken from title config.

RpcUrl.description: Read-only. Public RPC URL of the network from the platform registry (when it has no ticker). Never taken from title config.

SignatureEpoch.description: Contract/program signature epoch. Must match the on-chain value (RewardPool.signatureEpoch / Config.signature_epoch) — it is bound into the signed voucher. Bumping it on-chain revokes all outstanding vouchers; update this field right after, or withdrawals stop working.

VaultDepositAddress.description: Solana-only: vault address for SPL deposits (if used).

BlockchainNftCollectionBinding.description: Binding of one NFT contract/collection to an item catalog. One contract = one collection.

ContractAddress.description: NFT contract address. EVM: ERC721/ERC1155 contract address. Solana: Metaplex collection mint address or collection identifier.

DepositsEnabled.description: Whether NFTs of this collection can be deposited into the game.

DisplayName.description: Display name of the collection (admin panel/logs).

ItemCatalogID.description: Item catalog ID (cfg.Item.Catalogs[CatalogID]) the collection is bound to.

WithdrawalsEnabled.description: Whether NFTs of this collection can be withdrawn from the game to a wallet.

BlockchainPlayAccessPolicy.description: Title login mode and play-access token requirements.

Mode.description: Open (default): any login method, no balance check. AnyWithLinkedWallet: any method except guest; play requires a signature-linked wallet meeting TokenGates. WalletOnly: only wallet login allowed.

TokenGates.description: Balance requirements, all must pass. Wallet gates (OnChain/Combined) apply to the network of the player's chosen wallet; InGame gates always apply. Empty in a closed mode = no balance requirement, only the login-method restriction.

BlockchainSystemState.description: Global blockchain feature switches on top of per-network ones.

BlockchainWalletLoginPolicy.description: Wallet login policy. The client requests a challenge, signs it, the server recovers the address. Token balance requirements are Blockchain.PlayAccess. Public data only.

Enabled.description: Whether wallet login is enabled at all. False makes the endpoints reject the request.

ShowOnLoginScreen.description: Show the 'Sign in with wallet' button on the game's sign-in screen even when the title's login mode is Open. By default the button appears only in a token-gated login mode. Takes effect only together with Enabled.

WalletConnectProjectId.description: WalletConnect Cloud / Reown project id (dashboard.reown.com). Public value, safe to embed in the client. Enables mobile wallet login via WalletConnect (QR on desktop, deep-link on phones). Empty means only browser-extension wallets are offered and mobile login does not work. Each title provides its own id.

PlayerWithdrawalsSwitch.description: Player withdrawal switch of the title. Read-only for config writes; changed only by the owner's consent action.

ChangedAt.description: When the switch was last changed (UTC).

ChangedBy.description: Publisher user who last changed the switch.

ConsentID.description: ID of the consent journal record of the last change.

Enabled.description: Whether players may withdraw crypto from this title.

WalletPlayTokenGate.description: One wallet-balance requirement for play access. Token contract and on-chain decimals are resolved from CryptoCurrencyDefinition.Networks by (CurrencyID, NetworkID), not duplicated here.

BalanceSource.description: Where to read the balance compared against MinBalance: OnChain (wallet balance via RPC only), Combined (on-chain + in-game available balance InventoryV2.CryptoCurrencies[CurrencyID].Amount, excluding Frozen), InGame (in-game available balance only; no wallet, no RPC, NetworkID ignored). Default OnChain.

CurrencyID.description: CurrencyID (cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies) whose balance is checked. Its binding for NetworkID provides ContractAddress (mint for Solana) and Decimals.

DenyMessage.description: Optional custom denial message shown to the client (otherwise a default text is used).

Enabled.description: Whether the requirement is active. False skips this gate (does not block).

MinBalance.description: Minimum balance in whole units (e.g. 1000 = 1000 game tokens).

NetworkID.description: Network this gate applies to (key from Blockchain.Networks).

value.description: V2 definition of the title's blockchain integration. Contains only public data safe for clients (chain IDs, contracts, feature switches, safety policies). Private data lives in TitlePrivateConfiguration.

AccountSafety.description: Account safety policies for crypto operations.

IframeConnectHosts.description: Extra hosts (bare hostname, no scheme/path) the title's game may send network requests to (fetch/WebSocket) while embedded in an idosgames.com iframe. Requests only: framing a non-platform site inside idosgames.com is never allowed, so the game build must be hosted on the platform. Platform hosts are always allowed. Wallet-connection hosts are rejected on save.

PlayAccess.description: Title login mode and the token balance required to play. Open = any login method, no balance check (default). AnyWithLinkedWallet = any method except guest; play only with a signature-linked wallet meeting TokenGates. WalletOnly = only wallet login; its wallet must meet TokenGates. Balance is re-checked on every session ticket issue (login and refresh).

PlayerWithdrawals.description: Read-only. Whether players of this title may withdraw crypto out of the game. Absent = off. Only the title owner can switch it, in the dashboard, after accepting the legal responsibility terms; config writes (dashboard, MCP, DEV/PROD transfer) never change it. Works only while the platform also allows player withdrawals.

SystemState.description: Global blockchain feature switches (on top of per-network ones).

WalletLogin.description: Wallet-signature login/registration — one of the login methods. Who may play and with what token balance is Blockchain.PlayAccess.
